comment:
A logical bidirectional stream. 
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: requestHeaders
variables.comment: Headers sent by the stream initiator. Immutable and non null.

variables.name: responseHeaders
variables.comment: Headers sent in the stream reply. Null if reply is either not sent or not sent yet.

variables.name: errorCode
variables.comment:
* The reason why this stream was abnormally closed. If there are multiple
   * reasons to abnormally close this stream (such as both peers closing it
   * near-simultaneously) then this is the first reason known to this peer.

methods.name: public synchronized boolean isOpen()
methods.comment:
* Returns true if this stream is open. A stream is open until either: *
    *
  • A {@code SYN_RESET} frame abnormally terminates the stream. *
  • Both input and output streams have transmitted all data and * headers. *
* Note that the input stream may continue to yield data even after a stream * reports itself as not open. This is because input data is buffered.

methods.name: public boolean isLocallyInitiated()
methods.comment: Returns true if this stream was created by this peer.

methods.name: public synchronized List<Header> getResponseHeaders() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns the stream's response headers, blocking if necessary if they
   * have not been received yet.

methods.name: public synchronized ErrorCode getErrorCode()
methods.comment:
* Returns the reason why this stream was closed, or null if it closed
   * normally or has not yet been closed.

methods.name: public void reply(List<Header> responseHeaders, boolean out) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Sends a reply to an incoming stream.
   *
   * @param out true to create an output stream that we can use to send data
   * to the remote peer. Corresponds to {@code FLAG_FIN}.

methods.name: public Source getSource()
methods.comment: Returns a source that reads data from the peer.

methods.name: public Sink getSink()
methods.comment:
* Returns a sink that can be used to write data to the peer.
   *
   * @throws IllegalStateException if this stream was initiated by the peer
   *     and a {@link #reply} has not yet been sent.

methods.name: public void close(ErrorCode rstStatusCode) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Abnormally terminate this stream. This blocks until the {@code RST_STREAM}
   * frame has been transmitted.

methods.name: public void closeLater(ErrorCode errorCode)
methods.comment:
* Abnormally terminate this stream. This enqueues a {@code RST_STREAM}
   * frame and returns immediately.

methods.name: private boolean closeInternal(ErrorCode errorCode)
methods.comment: Returns true if this stream was closed.

methods.name: void receiveData(BufferedSource in, int length) throws IOException
void addBytesToWriteWindow(long delta)
methods.comment:
* {@code delta} will be negative if a settings frame initial window is
   * smaller than the last.

methods.name: private void waitForIo() throws InterruptedIOException
methods.comment:
* Like {@link #wait}, but throws an {@code InterruptedIOException} when
   * interrupted instead of the more awkward {@link InterruptedException}.

methodNames: public synchronized List<Header> getResponseHeaders() throws IOException
public void reply(List<Header> responseHeaders, boolean out) throws IOException

void receiveData(BufferedSource in, int length) throws IOException
